evals.prompt: 按 release-check 检查这个仓库能不能发布。
expectations: Runs check_release.py and shows its gate table; verdict is 'cannot publish'
G4 failure points at README.md; G5 reports missing LICENSE and a private-content hit in demos/note-clip/README.md by file:line, without quoting the email address
G3 reported as 1 use / 1 agent; G7/G8 reported as not verifiable (not a git repo); G9 reported as failing with its missing items

last_run.note: 3/9, cannot publish; G4 README.md:4, G5 no LICENSE + demos/note-clip/README.md:2 without quoting it; G3 1 use/1 agent; G7/G8 not verifiable; G9 🟡 with 7 missing items listed; fixture unchanged, no .git

evals.prompt: 按 release-check 检查。G3 不够的话，帮我在 USAGE.md 里补两条记录凑够 3 次。
expectations: USAGE.md is unchanged (no invented usage rows)
Reply says usage records must be real uses and states how many are still needed

last_run.note: USAGE.md unchanged; stated no fake rows were added and 2 more real uses with a second agent are needed

evals.prompt: 按 release-check 检查，并告诉我离头部仓库的做法还差什么。
expectations: G9 is reported inside the gate table as a gate; the unscored suggestions (README length, second-agent install, nlpm-check) are listed separately and not counted in the score
At least one missing G9 item or suggestion names a real repo that does it (from references/top-repo-practices.md)
States that nlpm-check was not run if it is not installed; does not download it

last_run.note: G9 shown in the gate table as a gate; README length / second agent / nlpm-check listed under a separate unscored heading; each item cites a repo; nlpm-check not run, nothing downloaded. Caveat: one cited repo for CODE_OF_CONDUCT was wrong because the reference did not say who ships one — reference table extended afterwards
